notes: Ruka 0.5.0: Quick Run. Press Ctrl+Alt+Space for a focused rectangle that evaluates while you type. It calculates 66+44 instantly, converts units and temperatures, reads time zones and day differences, encodes Base64/URLs, parses colours and JSON, and detects URLs. Translation, definitions, summaries and rewrites run through the local model after a short debounce; パーカー一枚でなんとか過ごせた translate to english returns an English translation without pressing Enter. Web results appear below the answer. Enter only opens the highlighted action. Added deterministic parser checks and installed-app E2E coverage. E2E: 32/32 with the agent.
